# Legal Policy Generator
> Free legal document generator for websites and apps

## About
Legal Policy Generator (legalpolicygen.com) is a free, no-signup tool that generates professional legal documents including Privacy Policies, Terms & Conditions, NDAs, EULAs, DPAs, DMCA policies, and more. All documents are GDPR/CCPA/WCAG compliant.

## Tools (22)
- Privacy Policy Generator
- Terms of Service Generator
- Terms & Conditions Generator
- Cookie Policy Generator
- Cookie Consent Banner Generator
- Refund Policy Generator
- Disclaimer Generator
- Robots.txt Generator
- Accessibility Statement Generator
- NDA Generator
- EULA Generator
- Data Processing Agreement (DPA) Generator
- Acceptable Use Policy (AUP) Generator
- DMCA Policy Generator
- Employee Privacy Policy Generator
- Affiliate Disclaimer Generator
- Social Media Policy Generator
- Newsletter Policy Generator
- HIPAA Notice Generator
- SLA Generator
- Data Breach Notification Generator
- AI Ethics Policy Generator

## Features
- Compliance Checker: Paste any policy to analyze for missing clauses
- Policy Starter Kit: Generate multiple documents at once
- Policy Guide: Learn which policies your business needs
- Policy History: Track previously generated documents
- Multi-language: English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Arabic
